pos.personaBrief: Wikipedia: 4-4-2 solid with quick transitions and counter-attacks at Grêmio/Palmeiras; Portugal more passing but pragmatic. Game management showed control without obsession over the ball.

pro.personaBrief: Quick transitions and counters, strong aerial play and set pieces (Trivela, Lance) point to vertical, direct attacks; midfielders ran through central areas.

est.personaBrief: Disciplined 4-4-2/4-2-2-2 with defined roles and wide players keeping width (Arce, Figo/Ronaldo on flanks), tactical discipline per Itatiaia; little tiki-taka.

lar.personaBrief: Crossing full-backs (Arce), aerial goals, wing-backs Cafu and Roberto Carlos in 2002, wingers Figo and Ronaldo in 2006: width is central.

blo.personaBrief: Solid, compact 4-4-2 with strong defensive midfielders; pressing attempts in late stages, intensity and combative style, but defensive solidity first.

mar.personaBrief: No explicit evidence; combative Brazilian-school tradition with strong marking midfielders and a back three with cover, leaning man-oriented.

pla.personaBrief: Record 2008: averse to changing the scheme according to opponents, only when losing; imposes his model and keeps the plan, though he did change to a back three in 2002.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic winner: copeiro style, won finals on penalties, said he deserved to be remembered for results; emphasis on pragmatism and psychology.

sis.personaBrief: Tactical discipline and collective duty above all (Itatiaia), but he trusted Ronaldo, kept Rivaldo free; star sits if not doing the job.

jog.personaBrief: Aerial strength, set pieces, firm defensive midfielders (Dinho, Goiano), combative teams; but also valued skilled players like Deco and Ronaldo.

bas.personaBrief: Builds with signings and veterans mixed with some youngsters; in 2002 average age 26.1 and old guard in Portugal; youth not a priority.

lid.personaBrief: Firm with affection (Arce): the boss, same rules for everyone, left out Romário and Djalminha, vetoed Baía, and refused pressure; also builds a family group.
